column3: FERN: Yeah, I was caught off guard by you fighting in Doubles.
Isn't that just a cheap way to cover for your lack of skill?
AYA: I can fight in whatever format I want.
Besides, it was my brother who--
LANA: AYA, YOU HAVE ANOTHER VISITOR!
AYA: REALLY, another one?
FERN: Can't blame people for wanting a free Badge.
AYA: Would you shut up please?
Just leave me alone.
HARDY: Did I come at a bad time?
FERN: Oh, it's you.
HARDY: Yea, it's me. What're you doin' here?
FERN: Sweepin' scrubs. You?
HARDY: Heard we got a new Gym Leader recently, so I'd been meaning to come down and welcome her to the club.
HARDY: You're Aya, yeah?
AYA: Um, yeah.
HARDY: Name's Hardy. Reborn's Rock Leader, at your service!
HARDY: Yanno, the plan was to give you a warm welcome, but...
Looks like you kinda already got a sour one, huh, mate?
FERN: You can keep the snide comments to yourself, thanks.
AYA: So you two know each other?
HARDY: 'Fraid so.
I had the misfortune of being stuck in the same class as Fern in the Onyx Trainers' School.
FERN: In short, Hardy's jealous because I was the top dog and he was just another loser.
HARDY: Keep tellin' yourself that, mate.
FERN: Plus our sisters used to be close friends, so we happened to get dragged to places together sometimes.
HARDY: Aye. That's all in the past though.
AYA: Yeah, okay, you guys keep chit-chatting.
I'm gonna go heal up my Pokémon with the machine in the other room.
FERN: So, \PN, you thinking of fighting Aya already?
Like I said, total pushover.
But it would be a shame if you came all the way down here and didn't have at least one good battle.
Lemme help you out there, huh?
HARDY: I think seein' Fern get beat is worth the trip out here in itself.
FERN: Stow it, Rocky.
I was going easy on \PN.
After all, I wouldn't want to make anyone cry.
HARDY: Whatever ya say, mate.
AYA: Okay. \PN, right?
If you're ready for your battle, let's get started.
FERN: Oh, I wanna see this.
Popcorn all the way, baby.
HARDY: I'll referee the match.
Someone's gotta keep Fern in check, an' I know the ropes from my own gym.
AYA: Ready when you are, I guess.
AYA: Take your place so we get this over with.
FERN: I'm not sure who I want to lose more.
AYA: Do you just hate everyone by default, or what?
FERN: Nah, just you.
HARDY: Hey, lay off o' her, mate.
AYA: No, no! It's fine, it's perfectly fine.
He's right.
It's not like I'm good at this.
I shouldn't even bother.
HARDY: Hey, now's not the time to doubt yourself.
Chin up.
You're gonna rock this fight.
AYA: I'd be better off if everyone just left me alone.
HARDY: The challenger, \PN, faces the Leader, Aya, in a six-on-six Double Battle!
AYA: I don't even really want to do this.
I just got saddled with it.
HARDY: Either competitor can make substitutions.
The battle's over when all six of either Trainer's Pokémon can no longer fight!
AYA: We're doing this again...
Why can't you just leave me alone?
HARDY: You both did great last time.
Let's give it all ya got this time too, aye?
The challenger, \PN, will rematch the Leader, Aya, in a six-on-six Double Battle!
Either competitor can make substitutions.
The battle is over when all six of either Trainer's Pokémon can no longer fight!
And roll!
AYA: So I lost.
At least that means I don't have to deal with you again, I guess.
FERN: Cold.
I think I woulda preferred it if \PN had bombed after all.
Whatever. Later, losers!
HARDY: Heyo, Aya, don't take a couple losses too hard, aye?
It happens, and you put up a solid fight.
You just psyched yourself out beforehand.
AYA: I don't care.
HARDY: C'mon, no need to be so cold about it.
AYA: What, you sensitive to rejection too?
HARDY: Nah, I mean you're being cold to yourself.
You deserve better than that, aye?
AYA: ...Whatever.
I never wanted this anyway.
It was never supposed to be my job.
But my stupid baby brother dumped this onto me.
Emphasis on the baby.
AYA: He probably hates us.
HARDY: Why would he hate you?
AYA: Ask him. I'm just not a good person, I guess.
But he hasn't talked to any of us since he ran away.
One day he just up and left.
Didn't say good bye.
Didn't even take his Pokémon with him.
He was the one who went out and earned the Gym Leader title.
And then he decided he was over it.
So now I'm stuck doing it.
Mom won't even talk about him anymore.
And I'm not cut out for this.
HARDY: Hey, calm down already, a'ite? You're fine.
Tell ya what-- why don't I stick around for a bit and help you guys out with some stuff?
AYA: Why? Just leave me alone.
HARDY: Nah, I don't think that'd be a good move right about now.
Why don't you start by giving \PN their righteously- earned badge?
Then you and I'll get stuff worked out, aye?
AYA: Sure.
AYA: This is the Blight Badge. Take it.
\PN received the Blight Badge!
AYA: Pokémon up to level 50 will listen to you now.
And you can use the Machine Strength outside of battle.
...And I guess I'm supposed to give you this.
AYA: Sludge Wave hits every target, and has a chance to poison each of them.
Go figure, all I'm good for is spreading something toxic like that.
AYA: You can go now.
HARDY: \PN, I look forward to seein' you in my Gym up in Agate City someday.
Don't let me down, aye?
Peace!
AYA: There's no point in trying to hash this out with you.
You'll just get bored and either hate me or leave me.
Just like everyone else.
HARDY: ...You wanna bet?
AYA: What?
HARDY: Let's bet on it.
AYA: Like money?
HARDY: Yeah, like money.
If you're so sure of that, you shouldn't need to hesitate, right?
As long as there's some doubt, you may as well either try.
Or make a penny off of it instead, yanno?
AYA: ...Hmph.
HARDY: Good luck, mate.
FERN: Good luck, I guess.
That seems to be the only way you win.
HARDY: I don't think anyone likes seein' anyone sad.
So come on, talk to me, mate.
AYA: ...Why are you even bothering with me?
Am I just some defenseless girl you think you can pick up this way?
Self-esteem issues like the hero signal for you to swoop in and save the day?
HARDY: Mate, if I'm makin' you uncomfortable, you can let me know and I'll back off stat.
But that wasn't what this was.
This was a courtesy call, and then I saw someone who really looks like they could use some help.
Will you just take it?
CAIN: This is the old Yureyu building that was destroyed in the earthquakes...
Haha, it's kinda creepy, huh?
Could they really be in here?
CAIN: Hey, \PN, I'm gonna follow your lead here.
Never really done the whole "team up" thing before, so...
S-so be gentle, s-senpai; it's my first time!
CAIN: Heyyyyy, ready to go?
I think we've kept them waiting long enough as is.
CAIN: Heyy, are you really gonna take off at a time like this?
I'll just hang here, I guess.
3F GATE OPEN
5F GATE OPEN
GRUNT: That girl is good...
You sure she doesn't wanna work for us?
GRUNT: Oh well! I'm sure the boss already has what he needs!
TARA: The day when Team Meteor rebuilds is coming closer and closer~
Even if we lose now, it won't matter!
Soon, the world can be transformed into a true paradise!
SIMON: We're not evil.
We're trying to fix things.
Although people may be hurt, or even die, when we recreate the world, their suffering will be erased.
Perhaps, even those that have been wronged can be restored to life...
HEATHER: ...
SIGMUND: And so you're here again.
SIGMUND: So, you've come again.
SIGMUND: I confess it was fortunate that Sirius of this "Team Meteor" came to me with the proposal that he did.
He had the means to capture my fugitives, and for payment he needed only to extract from this girl a single object--
A Ruby Ring.
CAIN: If it's just the ring you want, what are you even doing, keeping her up here?
SIGMUND: I ask myself the same.
Treatment has not been called for, if that is your concern.
At Sirius' behest, I was to detain and question her.
But that is demonstratedly fruitless, given that she has become withdrawn to the point of silence...
CAIN: And whose fault do you think that is?
After what you did to her, she may not even be able to speak at all!
SIGMUND: Loss of speech is not among the effects of electroconvulsive therapy.
Trust me to know my trade.
She has most certainly not lost her ability to speak.
Only her will.
And yet, you appear to have constructed a certain image of me in your mind already.
Do you intend to fight me regardless of what I say?
SIGMUND: Just as well.
Then I won't stop you from proceeding onwards.
SIGMUND: I may have invested myself in this "Team Meteor", but I have no regard for their malevolent actions.
Yet, I am bound to their service for a different reason entirely--
Strictly a matter of my personal curiosity.
There's a name I hear thrown about among their officers.
It's a name I used to know, but it cannot possibly be...
Pardon, I was speaking too much.
This time only, I will turn away.
When you flee, I will not stop this girl from joining you.
This is hardly a therapeutic environment anyway...
SIGMUND: So be it.
I'm sure this will be settled in short order nevertheless.
CAIN: Heather, are you okay?
CAIN: Bleh. Still nothing, huh?
What's wrong...?
SIGMUND: I haven't the mind to humor a battle currently.
There is much I must consider instead...
Do not expect the same favor in the future.
SIRIUS: Is that so, Doctor?
ANNA: \PN! Cain!
CAIN: Heyy, we finally made it!
SIRIUS: So you failed to defend your patients, and now you expect me to bail you out?
SIGMUND: I was simply informing you...
SIRIUS: Doctor, it was your goal to keep the children captive-- not mine.
All I sought was to obtain a certain artifact.
SIGMUND: You were the one who insisted they be kept for--
SIRIUS: Of course, I hadn't expected to find two of them.
SIRIUS: Did no one teach you to knock before entering?
This is my private office.
I would appreciate due courtesy.
Did the Doctor falter already?
I heard no commotion downstairs.
CAIN: He didn't even try.
SIRIUS: Senile old man.
He was the one who wanted to detain the children.
I thought we might have had a useful partnership,
But he drivels on and on about 'stress response' this and 'traumatic event' that...
At least he was good for his employees.
That, and...
It's strange, isn't it?
We needed only ensnare Ruby, and we caught Amethyst, too.
ANNA: Give me back my pendant!
It's-- It's the only thing I have left of my father...
SIRIUS: Your father?
Ah.
I suppose I can see the resemblance.
ANNA: You knew my dad?!
SIRIUS: He was a fool.
The unrefined, short-sighted type.
The type that history tries too hard to forget.
ANNA: Don't say things like that!
SIRIUS: Ah, but it is so true.
The gems of your ever-so-precious pendant that he gave you--
They were not always the brilliant, polished crystal you know.
Stones must be cut to be shaped.
People are the same.
Sometimes the stone breaks if you make the wrong cut.
And your father, the miserable, treacherous lout that he was...
Well, he was very broken indeed.
CAIN: Heyy buddy, I think you should stop talking and give the girl back her stuff.
SIRIUS: Is that what you think I should do?
This conflict is as pointless as it is annoying.
SIRIUS: "Her" stuff.
It was ours before she was ever born.
This Amethyst Pendant and the Ruby Ring both.
You don't have so much as an inkling of their true worth.
I will NOT relinquish such items for mere sentimentalities.
CAIN: Then we'll just have to make you!
Let's go, \PN!
SIRIUS: Enough!
This conflict is as pointless as it is infuriating!
Do not presume to be in control of the situation after such a trifling victory.
After all...
ANNA: Ow--
SIRIUS: Need I say more?
SIGMUND: Sirius, I cannot abide by this.
SIRIUS: Nor can you stop it.
ANNA: Cain...?
CAIN: Hey-- Hey, no--
Nobody wants this to happen, right?
We can work this out, right?
SIRIUS: I wonder.
CAIN: Wait-- I know.
Look, you lost a shipment, right?
I picked this up-- it was supposed to reach you.
This, uhhh, green crystal thing?
SIRIUS: ...You have the Emerald Brooch.
And here I thought that old zealot's daughter still had it.
It seems this truly is history in the making.
The Brooch for her life, then.
CAIN: Sure, whatever, yeah...
SIRIUS: Give it here, boy, and slowly-- no sudden movements.
Cain handed over the Emerald Brooch!
SIRIUS: Go.
ANNA: U-um...
Hey, uh, Nostra says we need to leave here right away...
CAIN: You don't have to tell me twice.
Let's skedaddle!
SIRIUS: To have three of the four already...
How marvelous.
SIGMUND: Sirius, I have some... concerns.
SIRIUS: Not now, Doctor.
You've been useless enough already.
Are you determined to make yourself a detriment?
SIGMUND: I...
SIRIUS: Leave me.
SIRIUS: ...No, hold on.
Something is not right here.
The luster is not quite...
SIRIUS: This isn't the Brooch.
Have I been tricked?
No, this isn't a crystal at all-- it would not cut like this.
But I have seen this before, this...
No, this is--
Verdignite!
SHELLY: What was that explosion?!
CAIN: No idea, just keep running!
NOEL: Anna, are you okay?
ANNA: I'm-- fine! Nothing's wrong!
CHARLOTTE: Heather, keep up!
We're almost out of here!
CAIN: Shelly!
GRUNT: Now, don't take another step closer or we'll cut her throat.
SHELLY: \PN...
C-Cain...
GRUNT: Just keep moving, and we'll pretend we didn't see anything. Got it?
SHELLY: I'm scared...
CAIN: They said you wouldn't hurt her!
GRUNT: Not if you don't interfere.
CAIN: Hey, now...
SHELLY: I-it's okay...
J-just... go on...
It doesn't matter what happens t-to me...
Find th-the others... okay...?
CAIN: Ugh...
I'm sorry, Shelly.
We'll come back for you! I promise!
GRUNT: Hey! Back off unless you want her to get hurt.
CAIN: Charlotte!
CHARLOTTE: It's about time you showed up, Princess.
CAIN: We came as soon as we could!
...Not in the usual way.
GRUNT: Back away or we'll kill her!
CHARLOTTE: Really, guys?
You're still on that?
GRUNT: Well, uh, you know,
It's what the boss said to say, so...
CHARLOTTE: Sirius, right?
Whatever, just forget it for now.
Come on, meet my friends.
This is \PN, and this is Princess.
\PN, Princess, meet Simon and Tara.
SIMON: We've met.
TARA: Yeah, \PN beat us before.
I'm still mad about that!
CAIN: To be fair, didn't you kinda start it?
Waitwaitwait, Charlotte--
What do you mean "friends"?
With Team Meteor?
CHARLOTTE: They're people too.
They just happen to be on a different side than you.
CAIN: And you!
CHARLOTTE: Details.
It beats being tied up, anyhow.
SIMON: It's not like we can just let you go because of a casual conversation.
